brief:
Hi team,

Solara is launching an SPF 50 face mist on March 3 and we'd love your help casting it. We're looking for 6 creators to post one reel each. Skincare or beauty creators, women, ideally between 50K and 300K followers with a mostly US audience. Total budget is $30,000. Please no one with a competing sunscreen deal. Drafts would be due Feb 20.

Thanks,
Mara

Brief from Volt Energy: new zero-sugar energy drink, 12oz cans, $2.49 at retail. Need 4 fitness creators in Florida, one reel + 3 stories each. $1,500 per creator max. No one tied to another energy drink brand. Go-live Jan 15.

Lune & Co here. We're putting together a spring wedding guest dress edit and want fashion creators to style it. Women in their twenties, any size following. We have $10K total and would like 5 creators if the budget allows. Launch is April 4; content due March 21.

Client: Halo Hair
Product: bond repair hair oil (50ml, $38)
Creators: 8 hair or beauty creators, 100K+ followers, at least 60% US audience
Budget: $45,000 all in
Usage: 30 days paid usage
Exclusivity: no current haircare partnerships
Timeline: drafts Feb 10, live Feb 24

Hey, Stride Athletics here. We're dropping the Tempo 3 road shoe next month and want runners to review it. Thinking three creators, preferably 20K to 100K followers. US audience matters less for this one. Budget's around $6,000 total. We can't use anyone with a running shoe non-compete.
Northfield is launching a daily moisturiser with SPF for men. We'd like five male skincare or lifestyle creators aged 25 to 34 for one reel each, up to $3,000 per creator.

Fwd: creator ask

From: Priya at Peak Nutrition

We're launching a vanilla whey protein, 30 servings a tub. We want 5 fitness or food creators with a mostly US audience and over 30K followers. $12k total for creators. Nobody under contract with another protein brand please. First posts the week of Feb 9.

Petal Beauty is launching a tinted lip oil (six shades, $22). Looking for 10 beauty creators, women 20 to 29, micro to mid-size, roughly 10K to 150K followers, with at least half their audience in the US. We have $25K for all of the creators together. Reels due March 6.
Need: 6 fitness or wellness creators based in California or Texas for a leggings launch (Form Studio). $2,000 each. No activewear exclusives.

Brand: Aster Cosmetics
Launch: skin tint foundation, 24 shades, on shelves 3/15
Ask: 4 beauty creators over 250K followers, 65%+ US audience, reel + usage
Budget: $40,000 total
Must not be exclusive with another makeup brand.
Dusk makes a magnesium sleep supplement. We're small, $3,000 total, and would love three wellness creators who actually talk about sleep. Women over 30 preferred but not required.

Kicks Depot (sneaker retailer) wants 5 streetwear creators in New York or Los Angeles for a store opening on May 2. Men or women. Total creator budget: $8,000. Skip anyone exclusive with another sneaker retailer.
